Container.Name: Lune
Container.Overview: Your universe. Your media. Lune is a self-hosted media server with built-in HTTPS and security, so there's no separate reverse proxy to set up. Direct Play, hardware-accelerated streaming, multi-user accounts with 2FA, and built-in media requests.

Config.Name: Web HTTP Port
Config.Description: HTTP port used for local, reverse proxy, or Tailscale modes

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database, TLS certs, cached artwork, and transcode scratch

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Read-only mount for your media directories

Config.Name: Access / Edge Mode
Config.Description: Choose how Lune is accessed: 'local' (LAN HTTP :5863), 'acme' (built-in Let's Encrypt HTTPS :443/:80), 'proxy' (behind NPM/SWAG/Traefik/Caddy :5863), or 'tailscale' (Tailscale Serve / Unraid Tailscale :5863)

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional canonical external URL (e.g. https://lune.example.com or https://lune.tailnet.ts.net) for Secure cookies and invite links

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership in /data (Unraid default: 99 / nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership in /data (Unraid default: 100 / users)

Config.Name: HTTPS Port (ACME)
Config.Description: Optional embedded HTTPS port for LUNE_EDGE_MODE=acme (Unraid WebGUI uses host 443; use a custom br0 IP or map to a free host port)

Config.Name: HTTP Redirect / ACME Port
Config.Description: Optional HTTP-01 challenge and redirect port for LUNE_EDGE_MODE=acme (Unraid WebGUI uses host 80; leave blank when using Cloudflare DNS-01)

Config.Name: Domain
Config.Description: Public domain name for automatic TLS certificate issuance (required when Edge Mode is 'acme')

Config.Name: ACME Email
Config.Description: Contact email for Let's Encrypt notifications (optional, for 'acme' mode)

Config.Name: Trusted Reverse Proxies
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated reverse proxy IPs/CIDRs allowed to supply X-Forwarded-For (e.g. 172.17.0.0/16)

Config.Name: ACME DNS Provider
Config.Description: Optional DNS-01 solver (set to 'cloudflare' to validate without port 80)

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token
Config.Description: Scoped Zone:DNS:Edit token when using Cloudflare DNS-01

Config.Name: TMDB API Key Override
Config.Description: Optional personal TMDB v3 API key override (leave blank to use the built-in default)

Config.Name: TMDB Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional custom TMDB proxy or base URL

Config.Name: Hardware Transcoding GPU
Config.Description: Optional Intel QuickSync / AMD VAAPI device passthrough (enter /dev/dri if your server has a supported GPU)
